subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2058
title: Provides that, for the estates of decedents dying on or after January 1, 2026, Oregon estate tax is not due unless the value of the Oregon taxable estate exceeds $13.99 million.
headline: HB 2058 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2058 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
